minute_display_notes: Rayo-Celta: official event card shows Giorgi Tsitaishvili at 46'; narrative commentary records 45'. Normalized minute follows event card.
Betis-Malaga: official event cards show Antony at 62' and Chupe at 61'; narrative commentary records 61'/60'. Normalized minutes follow event cards.
Racing-Real Madrid: official event card shows Íñigo Sainz-Maza at 61'; narrative commentary records 60'. Normalized minute follows event card.

Verify Villarreal's 10-player bench and Getafe/Rayo/Celta/Racing bench list counts against official match sheets; do not infer missing substitutes.
